description: Chapter summaries the reader shows under a chapter's title, keyed by chapter number, per language. Like section headings they are editorial aids, not translation: written from Open Word Bible's own wording, stating what the chapter is about and nothing more, so every language can say the same thing. They use no reader settings. Every summary is an AI draft until a named reviewer approves it.

1.en: Zechariah calls the people to return to God, as their ancestors did not. In a night vision horsemen report that the earth is at rest, and God promises to return to Jerusalem with compassion.
1.sw: Zekaria anawaita watu wamrudie Mungu, kama mababu zao hawakufanya. Katika maono ya usiku wapanda farasi wanaripoti kwamba dunia imetulia, na Mungu anaahidi kurudi Yerusalemu kwa huruma.
1.am: ዘካርያስ አባቶቻቸው እንዳላደረጉት ሕዝቡ ወደ እግዚአብሔር እንዲመለሱ ይጠራቸዋል። በሌሊት ራእይ ፈረሰኞች ምድር ጸጥ እንዳለች ይናገራሉ፤ እግዚአብሔርም በርኅራኄ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም እንደሚመለስ ተስፋ ይሰጣል።

2.en: A man with a measuring line goes to measure Jerusalem, but God will be a wall of fire around it and the glory within it.
2.sw: Mtu mwenye kamba ya kupimia anakwenda kuipima Yerusalemu, lakini Mungu atakuwa ukuta wa moto kuizunguka na utukufu ndani yake.
2.am: የመለኪያ ገመድ የያዘ ሰው ኢየሩሳሌምን ሊለካ ይሄዳል፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን በዙሪያዋ የእሳት ቅጥር፣ በውስጧም ክብር ይሆናል።

3.en: Joshua the high priest stands before the angel with the Accuser opposing him, and his filthy clothes are replaced with clean ones. God will bring the servant, the Branch.
3.sw: Yoshua kuhani mkuu anasimama mbele ya malaika huku Mshtaki akimpinga, na mavazi yake machafu yanabadilishwa kwa mavazi safi. Mungu atamleta mtumishi, Chipukizi.
3.am: ሊቀ ካህናቱ ኢያሱ በመልአኩ ፊት ይቆማል፤ ከሳሹም ይቃወመዋል፤ የቆሸሸ ልብሱም በንጹሕ ልብስ ይለወጣል። እግዚአብሔር አገልጋዩን ቅርንጫፉን ያመጣል።

4.en: Zechariah sees a lampstand and two olive trees: not by might nor by power, but by God's Spirit, Zerubbabel will finish the temple.
4.sw: Zekaria anaona kinara cha taa na mizeituni miwili: si kwa nguvu za jeshi wala si kwa uwezo, bali kwa Roho wa Mungu, Zerubabeli atalimaliza hekalu.
4.am: ዘካርያስ መቅረዝንና ሁለት የወይራ ዛፎችን ያያል፦ ዘሩባቤል ቤተ መቅደሱን የሚፈጽመው በብርታት ወይም በኀይል ሳይሆን በእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ ነው።

5.en: A flying scroll carries a curse against thieves, and a woman in a basket representing wickedness is carried off to Babylon.
5.sw: Gombo linaloruka linabeba laana dhidi ya wezi, na mwanamke ndani ya kikapu anayewakilisha uovu anachukuliwa mpaka Babeli.
5.am: የሚበርር ጥቅልል በሌቦች ላይ እርግማን ይዟል፤ ክፋትን የምትወክል በቅርጫት ውስጥ ያለች ሴትም ወደ ባቢሎን ትወሰዳለች።

6.en: Four chariots go out to the four winds. A crown is placed on Joshua, and the man called the Branch will build the temple of God.
6.sw: Magari manne ya vita yanatoka kwenda pande nne za upepo. Taji inawekwa juu ya Yoshua, na mtu anayeitwa Chipukizi atajenga hekalu la Mungu.
6.am: አራት ሰረገሎች ወደ አራቱ ነፋሳት ይወጣሉ። በኢያሱ ላይ ዘውድ ይደረጋል፤ ቅርንጫፍ የተባለው ሰውም የእግዚአብሔርን ቤተ መቅደስ ይሠራል።

7.en: The people ask whether they should keep fasting, and God answers that they should do justice and show loyal love and compassion.
7.sw: Watu wanauliza kama waendelee kufunga, na Mungu anajibu kwamba wanapaswa kutenda haki na kuonyesha upendo usiokoma na huruma.
7.am: ሕዝቡ መጾማቸውን ይቀጥሉ እንደሆነ ይጠይቃሉ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ፍትሕን እንዲያደርጉ፣ ጽኑ ፍቅርንና ርኅራኄንም እንዲያሳዩ ይመልሳል።

8.en: God will return to Zion, and Jerusalem will be called the faithful city. The fasts will become joyful feasts, and many peoples will seek God.
8.sw: Mungu atarudi Sayuni, na Yerusalemu itaitwa Mji Mwaminifu. Mifungo itakuwa sikukuu za furaha, na mataifa mengi watamtafuta Mungu.
8.am: እግዚአብሔር ወደ ጽዮን ይመለሳል፤ ኢየሩሳሌምም የታማኝነት ከተማ ተብላ ትጠራለች። ጾሞቹ የደስታ በዓላት ይሆናሉ፤ ብዙ ሕዝቦችም እግዚአብሔርን ይፈልጋሉ።

9.en: God will judge the nations around Israel. Zion's king comes, righteous and victorious, humble and riding on a donkey, and will proclaim peace to the nations.
9.sw: Mungu atayahukumu mataifa yanayoizunguka Israeli. Mfalme wa Sayuni anakuja, mwenye haki na mshindi, mnyenyekevu na amepanda punda, naye atatangaza amani kwa mataifa.
9.am: እግዚአብሔር በእስራኤል ዙሪያ ባሉ ሕዝቦች ላይ ይፈርዳል። ጻድቅና ድል አድራጊ፣ ትሑትና በአህያ ላይ የተቀመጠው የጽዮን ንጉሥ ይመጣል፤ ለሕዝቦችም ሰላምን ያውጃል።

10.en: God will gather and strengthen the people of Judah and Joseph and bring them home.
10.sw: Mungu atawakusanya na kuwaimarisha watu wa Yuda na wa Yusufu na kuwarudisha nyumbani.
10.am: እግዚአብሔር የይሁዳንና የዮሴፍን ሕዝብ ይሰበስባል፤ ያበረታቸዋል፤ ወደ አገራቸውም ይመልሳቸዋል።

11.en: Zechariah shepherds the flock marked for slaughter, is paid thirty pieces of silver and breaks his staffs, Favor and Union.
11.sw: Zekaria analichunga kundi lililotengwa kwa ajili ya kuchinjwa, analipwa vipande thelathini vya fedha na kuzivunja fimbo zake, Fadhili na Umoja.
11.am: ዘካርያስ ለእርድ የተመደበውን መንጋ ይጠብቃል፤ ሠላሳ ብር ይከፈለዋል፤ ሞገስና አንድነት የተባሉትን በትሮቹንም ይሰብራል።

12.en: God will defend Jerusalem against the nations and pour out a spirit of grace and pleading, and they will mourn for the one they pierced.
12.sw: Mungu ataitetea Yerusalemu dhidi ya mataifa na kumimina roho ya neema na ya kuomba rehema, nao watamwombolezea yule waliyemtoboa.
12.am: እግዚአብሔር ኢየሩሳሌምን ከሕዝቦች ይከላከላል፤ የጸጋንና ምሕረትን የመለመንን መንፈስ ያፈስሳል፤ እነርሱም ስለ ወጉት ያለቅሳሉ።

13.en: A fountain will be opened to cleanse sin, and idols and false prophets will be removed. The shepherd will be struck and the sheep scattered.
13.sw: Chemchemi itafunguliwa ili kutakasa dhambi, na sanamu na manabii wa uongo wataondolewa. Mchungaji atapigwa na kondoo watatawanyika.
13.am: ኃጢአትን የሚያነጻ ምንጭ ይከፈታል፤ ጣዖታትና ሐሰተኛ ነቢያትም ይወገዳሉ። እረኛው ይመታል፤ በጎቹም ይበተናሉ።

14.en: A day of God is coming when the nations attack Jerusalem, and God will stand on the Mount of Olives. Living water will flow from Jerusalem, and God will be king over all the earth.
14.sw: Siku ya Mungu inakuja ambapo mataifa yanaishambulia Yerusalemu, na Mungu atasimama juu ya Mlima wa Mizeituni. Maji yaliyo hai yatatiririka kutoka Yerusalemu, na Mungu atakuwa mfalme juu ya dunia yote.
14.am: ሕዝቦች በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ አደጋ የሚጥሉበት የእግዚአብሔር ቀን ይመጣል፤ እግዚአብሔርም በደብረ ዘይት ላይ ይቆማል። የሕያው ውኃ ከኢየሩሳሌም ይፈልቃል፤ እግዚአብሔርም በምድር ሁሉ ላይ ንጉሥ ይሆናል።
